MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
NEUTRAL, with normal volatility at 26.8% but exceptionally narrow participation: only 1/8 sectors posted a positive 1W return. The technology and telecom sector was the sole gainer; all other sectors were negative.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology & Telecom led (1W: +8.87% | 1M: -8.40%), a RECOVERY; KONTR (1W: +32.61% | 1M: -8.50%) and TKFEN (1W: +12.39% | 1M: -17.29%) were notable movers. Construction & REIT was relatively resilient at -0.70% for the week, but remained BELOW TREND (1M: -10.86%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy & Chemicals was weakest (1W: -10.61% | 1M: -20.34%), BELOW TREND; Heavy Industry also remained weak (1W: -8.05% | 1M: -16.55%), BELOW TREND. GUBRF (1W: -24.51% | 1M: -38.47%) and VESTL (1W: -22.01% | 1M: -37.53%) were among the sharpest decliners.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
KONTR (1W: +32.61% | 1M: -8.50%) RECOVERY; TKFEN (1W: +12.39% | 1M: -17.29%) RECOVERY; ENKAI (1W: +4.29% | 1M: -7.03%) RECOVERY. ASELS (1W: +2.59% | 1M: +3.12%) ABOVE TREND; TSKB (1W: +0.79% | 1M: -7.26%) RECOVERY.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
GUBRF (1W: -24.51% | 1M: -38.47%) BELOW TREND; VESTL (1W: -22.01% | 1M: -37.53%) BELOW TREND; EREGL (1W: -15.50% | 1M: -17.47%) BELOW TREND. HEKTS (1W: -12.57% | 1M: -21.57%) BELOW TREND; SASA (1W: -11.59% | 1M: -19.44%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
The strongest 1W advances were KONTR (1W: +32.61% | 1M: -8.50%) RECOVERY, TKFEN (1W: +12.39% | 1M: -17.29%) RECOVERY and ENKAI (1W: +4.29% | 1M: -7.03%) RECOVERY. ASELS (1W: +2.59% | 1M: +3.12%) ABOVE TREND and TSKB (1W: +0.79% | 1M: -7.26%) RECOVERY also gained.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking & Finance remained BELOW TREND at -4.25% for the week and -5.70% for the month. TSKB (1W: +0.79% | 1M: -7.26%) RECOVERY contrasts with GARAN (1W: -2.57% | 1M: +1.87%) CORRECTION and AKBNK (1W: -5.73% | 1M: -9.10%) BELOW TREND.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy Industry was weak at -8.05% for the week and -16.55% for the month, BELOW TREND. ASELS (1W: +2.59% | 1M: +3.12%) ABOVE TREND stands out against FROTO (1W: -1.65% | 1M: -11.01%) BELOW TREND and EREGL (1W: -15.50% | 1M: -17.47%) BELOW TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Energy & Chemicals was the weakest sector, down 10.61% for the week and 20.34% for the month, BELOW TREND. TUPRS (1W: -2.48% | 1M: -8.70%) and PETKM (1W: -11.26% | 1M: -14.12%) were BELOW TREND, with GUBRF (1W: -24.51% | 1M: -38.47%) also BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain a defensive, selective stance and avoid broad exposure while only 1/8 sectors is positive and every sector is disqualified in the supplied quant rankings. Favor confirmation over chasing sharp rebounds; reassess risk if breadth improves and volatility remains contained.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
Monitor KONTR (1W: +32.61% | 1M: -8.50%) RECOVERY and TKFEN (1W: +12.39% | 1M: -17.29%) RECOVERY for evidence their rebounds persist. ASELS (1W: +2.59% | 1M: +3.12%) ABOVE TREND, ENKAI (1W: +4.29% | 1M: -7.03%) RECOVERY and TSKB (1W: +0.79% | 1M: -7.26%) RECOVERY are also on watch.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Technology & Telecom is the key test of whether the only positive sector can sustain its advance; it remains a RECOVERY on monthly performance. Watch Construction & REIT for stabilization and Energy & Chemicals for any easing in its pronounced BELOW TREND decline.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
No XU100 price levels were provided, so specific support or resistance levels cannot be stated. Key triggers are a broadening of positive sector returns beyond 1/8 and volatility moving below 25%; renewed deterioration in breadth would reinforce a defensive stance.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

The market remains NEUTRAL on normal volatility, but 1/8 positive sectors signals fragile, narrow participation. Technology led on a sharp rebound while Energy & Chemicals and Heavy Industry lagged; keep exposure selective and look for broader breadth confirmation before adding risk.
